title: Unity 6.4发布了，有什么新内容？！

# Unity 6.4 新特性图谱

## 版本支持层级
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    V6_3["6.3 LTS"]
    V6_4["6.4 Supported"]
    V6_5["6.5 Future"]
    SupportLevel["支持级别 (同等 LTS)"]
    Stability["高稳定性"]
    SupportEnd["支持结束时间"]
    V6_3 --> SupportLevel
    V6_4 --> SupportLevel
    V6_4 --> SupportEnd
    V6_5 --> SupportEnd
    SupportLevel --> Stability
```

## ECS 集成进引擎
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    ECS_External["外部 ECS 包 (需单独安装)"]
    UnityEditor["Unity 编辑器"]
    ECS_CorePkg["ECS Core 包 (实体)"]
    Integration["集成到引擎内部"]
    Benefit["无需单独安装"]
    Future["实体将成为引擎核心"]
    ECS_External --> Integration
    UnityEditor --> Integration
    ECS_CorePkg --> Integration
    Integration --> Benefit
    Integration --> Future
```

## 新增内置工具与编辑器扩展
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    ProjectAuditor["Project Auditor"]
    GraphToolkit["Graph Toolkit"]
    RenderingStats["渲染统计窗口"]
    PipelineConverter["渲染管线转换器"]
    InputMouse["鼠标行为 + 输入系统"]
    BurstWebGL["Burst 多线程 (WebGL)"]
    EditorExt["编辑器扩展能力"]
    ToolBenefit["提升开发体验 & 诊断效率"]
    ProjectAuditor --> ToolBenefit
    RenderingStats --> ToolBenefit
    PipelineConverter --> ToolBenefit
    InputMouse --> ToolBenefit
    BurstWebGL --> ToolBenefit
    GraphToolkit --> EditorExt
    EditorExt --> ToolBenefit
```

## 渲染、后期与资源工作流更新
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    CustomRender2D["2D 项目自定义渲染 (URP)"]
    PostProcessing["后期处理功能"]
    RuntimeSpriteAtlas["运行时创建 Sprite Atlas"]
    SpriteAtlasBenefit["支持模组 & 高渲染效率"]
    InputSystemMouse["鼠标输入系统集成"]
    BurstMultithread["Burst 多线程 (Web)"]
    Performance["整体性能提升"]
    UseCase["复杂渲染 / 特效实现"]
    CustomRender2D --> UseCase
    PostProcessing --> UseCase
    RuntimeSpriteAtlas --> SpriteAtlasBenefit
    SpriteAtlasBenefit --> Performance
    InputSystemMouse --> Performance
    BurstMultithread --> Performance
    UseCase --> Performance
```
